title: Borders Kept Open for Travellers from India and Indonesia Despite Large Number of Imported COVID-19 Cases from These Countries
what_it_is: Borders Kept Open for Travellers from India and Indonesia Despite Large Number of Imported COVID-19 Cases from These Countries

sections.label: Migrant workers inflow needed
sections.summary: Singapore needs continued migrant worker inflow, including construction workers and foreign domestic workers, to support key economic sectors and families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Singapore can ill afford to close ourselves off fully from the rest of the world.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We need a continued inflow of migrant workers to support our key economic sectors, including construction workers to build our homes and critical infrastructure and foreign domestic workers (FDWs) to support the care-giving needs of our families.

sections.label: COVID-19 border risk management measures
sections.summary: Travellers and migrant workers face stringent measures including pre-departure and on-arrival tests, 14-day Stay-Home Notice, extra isolation for CMP workers, and Rostered Routine Testing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Some of the travellers are our citizens, permanent residents or their close relatives here to visit them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Therefore, we need to adopt a risk management approach to the inflow of these travellers, rather than to close the borders to them entirely.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These migrant workers and visitors are subject to a set of stringent precautionary measures to keep the risk of COVID-19 transmission to our community as low as possible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These include pre-departure tests before they leave their country, on-arrival tests when they arrive in Singapore, and a 14-day Stay-Home Notice (SHN) at dedicated facilities, with another test before they complete their SHN and are allowed to leave the facility.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As an additional precaution, all newly arrived Work Permit and S Pass workers in the Construction, Marine and Process (CMP) sectors are subject to an additional seven-day isolation and testing regime at a designated facility following their 14-day SHN.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As an additional line of defence, to detect infections in the dormitories and high-risk workplaces early, workers in these settings such as those in the Aviation, Maritime and CMP sectors, are also required to undergo Rostered Routine Testing or RRT at least every 14 days.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As the global situation evolves, the Multi-Ministry Task Force will continue to review our border control measures to strike a balance between public health considerations and the needs of our society and economy.
